run_tav2_wb_conversion: run the tav2_wb conversion script to process TAv2-WB scenes into WAI format using the YAML config
process_tav2_wb_scene: process a single TAv2-WB scene by symlinking images and depth maps and storing intrinsics and poses in WAI format
symlink_images_and_depth: symlink RGB images and EXR depth maps from the raw TAv2-WB dataset to the WAI target directory structure
extract_intrinsics_and_poses: extract camera intrinsics and cam2world poses from numpy files and store them as WAI frame metadata
store_scene_metadata: store the scene metadata JSON with frame info, camera model, and modalities using the WAI store_data utility
